author: Billie Black
text:
Have been using Bruce septic since 2010 and they’ve always come through for us, if we have an issue with our system or if we just need our septic tanks cleaned. This year they’ve been extremely busy with all the rain so It was a bit of a wait a  for a tank cleaning which wasn’t an issue.
We have an older home which was remodeled so we actually have two separate septic tanks which they clean which they do without any problems.
I have never had issues with this company and they do quality work, I would definitely recommend them.

author: Rebecca Stankowski
text: Bruce Septic is responsive, communicative, respectful of property, and prompt. They do an excellent job; we have used them for over 25 years and recommend them highly.

author: Kevin
text: Very good company, from the first call to when it was all done very good customer care. Jim could have drained my septic tank but found the real issue and took care of it. And tracy was very helpful.

author: Karin Mason
text: The owner Tracey performed the service in a very professional way!  Courteous and friendly too!  Scheduled the date, called the day before to confirm time which was important to me so as I could plan the rest of the day due to my busy life style.  I would recommend Bruce for your septic needs in a heart beat.

author: Michael Layman
text: These people are absolutely AMAZING!!!!  On short notice and after hours they came and pumped my tanks and assisted the other company I foolishly called out first, after their tech dropped his keys down the pit.  They were very kind and prompt.  I strongly recommend using them and will continue to call them for all my needs from now on.
